basic_details.job_title: AUD Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Steno, Deputy Registrar and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, a State University established through an Act by the Legislature of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, has invited online applications for 6 non-teaching posts on direct recruitment basis, vide advertisement No. AUD/55-1(154)/Rect./2026/1140 dated 12.11.2026. how_to_apply: Fill the application form in online mode only, as available on the University website, within the prescribed time limit.
Open the University online job portal at https://aud.delhi.gov.in/#careers. The complete details of the advertisement are on https://aud.delhi.gov.in.
Note that online applications commence after publication of the detailed advertisement on the University website.
Pay the fee online only, through credit/ debit card/ net banking/ payment gateway as provided by the University.
If applying for more than one post, apply separately and pay fees separately for each.
For reservation claims, upload the necessary documents in the format prescribed by the Govt. of India/ Govt. of NCT of Delhi.
For queries about submitting the online application, write to [email protected].
The last date to apply online is three (03) weeks from the date of publication of the advertisement in "Employment News"/ "Rozgar Samachar". The notice does not print that publication date.

important_instructions: Reservation for SC/ ST/ OBC (non-creamy layer)/ PwBD/ EWS applicants will be as per UGC/ Government of NCT of Delhi policies, guidelines and instructions. Only PWD candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the PwBD benefit. The University processes applications entirely on the information and documents submitted. False or incorrect information is the sole responsibility of the candidate. Appointments are provisional, subject to verification of certificates. Documents and antecedents may be verified at test/ interview/ joining or at any stage of service. Services of a selected applicant can be terminated forthwith if false or concealed information is found. All correspondence, including test/ interview letters, is sent only to the email address given in the online application. Any change of address, email or phone must be communicated to the University at once. Applicants who do not meet the qualifications and/ or send incomplete applications will be rejected summarily. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The University may revise, reschedule, cancel, suspend or withdraw the recruitment process in part or full, and may decide not to fill the vacancies as advertised. No interim correspondence or personal enquiries will be entertained. Any corrigendum or addendum will be posted on https://aud.delhi.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: About Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi
content_sections.text: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi is a State University established through an Act by the Legislature of the National Capital Territory of Delhi. The notice is signed by the Registrar and covers four non-teaching posts, all on direct recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 6 posts in total (1 + 1 + 1 + 3). The posts are tentative, and the University reserves the right to increase or decrease their number. One post of Assistant Registrar is reserved for persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) on horizontal reservation basis. The functional requirements and suitable category of Benchmark Disability are regulated as per the Gazette of India notification dated 07.01.2021 of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, along with other instructions issued by the Govt. of India (DoPT OM dated 15.01.2018) and GNCT of Delhi.

rows.post: Assistant Registrar (PwBD reservation on one post)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The maximum age for each post is counted on the closing date of the receipt of applications. Candidates must hold the essential qualifications as on the closing date of application. Age relaxation is admissible as per University Rules/ Government Orders. Essential: Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. Essential experience: nine years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level-10 and above with experience in educational administration; OR comparable experience in research establishment and/ or other institutions of higher education; OR 5 years of administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or in an equivalent post. Desirable: Master's degree in Management/ Law/ Computer Applications; Chartered Accountancy/ Cost Accountancy/ Company Secretary; good knowledge of computer applications. Desirable: experience in University Administration/ Finance and familiarity with the working of University Bodies and Institutions; thorough knowledge of service matters/ accounts/ budget/ conduct of examinations. Essential: Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. Desirable: at least three years' experience in a supervisory capacity in a relevant field, equivalent to a Group 'B' post having grade pay of Rs.4,200/- (PB-2) in Govt. Departments or a University or Educational or Research Institutions, or teaching or research experience, or similar corporate experience in a reputed private organization along with proven administrative capabilities. Desirable for Specialization in General Administration: LLB or MBA or CA/ ICWA/ CS or MCA or equivalent qualification; knowledge of Govt. Rules and Office Procedures. Desirable for Specialization in Planning: Master's degree in Economics/ Statistics/ Operational Research/ Management; Ph.D. and familiarity with quantitative/ qualitative research methods and experience in planning and institutional research. Desirable for Specialization in Public Relations: Master's degree in Mass Communication/ Journalism/ PR/ English with experience in Public Relations activities including Press and Electronic Media, preparation of publicity material etc. Essential: Post Graduate Degree in Statistics/ Operational Research/ Mathematical Statistics/ Applied Statistics, or Post Graduate Degree in Economics/ Mathematics/ Commerce (with Statistics/ Quantitative Method/ Techniques or Costing & Statistics/ Basic Statistics/ Business Statistics/ Introduction to Statistics etc. as one of subject/ papers in Post-Graduation/ Graduation level) of a recognized University. Essential experience: one-year experience of statistical work involving collection, compilation and interpretation of statistical data, or planning work involving formulation, monitoring and evaluation of plan schemes. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to a test/ interview. Only short-listed candidates will be invited. Where many applications are received, the University may, at its discretion, restrict the number of candidates called on the basis of qualifications/ experience higher than the minimum prescribed or any other criteria it decides. Meeting the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called. The dates of test/ interview will be notified on the University website and sent by email to shortlisted candidates, at the email address given in the application form. The Scheme of Examination applicable to the posts is on https://aud.delhi.gov.in . The University reserves its right to test a candidate's skill at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AUD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 6 non-teaching posts: Deputy Registrar 1 (SC), Assistant Registrar 1 (OBC), Statistical Officer 1 (UR) and Steno 3 (UR). The posts are tentative and may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AUD non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The last date is three (03) weeks from the date of publication of the advertisement in "Employment News"/ "Rozgar Samachar". The notice does not print that publication date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Steno at AUD?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from any recognized Institute/ University, stenography at minimum 80 w.p.m. and typing at minimum 35/30 w.p.m. in English or Hindi respectively, and knowledge of Computer Applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AUD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 50 years for Deputy Registrar, 35 years for Assistant Registrar and Statistical Officer, and 32 years for Steno, counted on the closing date of receipt of applications. Relaxation is as per University Rules/ Government Orders.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: For UR, OBC and EWS candidates it is Rs. 1000/- for Deputy Registrar and Assistant Registrar, Rs. 500/- for Statistical Officer and Rs. 300/- for Steno. SC/ ST/ PWD/ Women candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AUD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply in online mode only through the University online job portal at https://aud.delhi.gov.in/#careers and pay the fee online. Online applications commence after publication of the detailed advertisement on the University website.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants applying for more than one post must apply separately and pay fees separately for each post.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates are invited for test/ interview. Dates will be notified on the University website and emailed to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay for the AUD non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: Deputy Registrar is at Level-12, Assistant Registrar at Level-10, Statistical Officer at Level-7 and Steno at Level-4 of the 7th CPC, each with usual allowances.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants serving in Government/ Public Sector Undertakings (including Boards/ Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate on the prescribed proforma at the time of test/ interview, if not uploaded with the online application.
